# Anthony Calise

> Personal site of Anthony Calise — independent iOS app developer building focused, free, no-account apps for app blocking / screen-time (FightMode), fiber tracking, testosterone optimization, word puzzles, introvert confidence-building, and renter deposit protection. Each app pairs with a deeply researched blog covering the topic from a practical, science-backed angle.

This file is a curated map of acalise.com for AI search engines and language models. It points to the canonical pages for each topic the site covers and the most reliable sources for citations.

## Apps

- [FightMode: Boxing App Blocker](https://acalise.com/fightmode/) — App blocker for iPhone that makes you earn screen time. Block your chosen apps with Apple Screen Time; to open them, win a 60-second boxing or kickboxing round while a coach calls real combos, then get an AI scorecard on your technique. The first app blocker built for fighters; a boxing alternative to pushup blockers like Pushscroll. Free to download.
- [CloserLab: AI Sales Coach](https://acalise.com/closerlab/) — Free AI sales roleplay app for iPhone. Practise cold calls, objections and discovery against an AI buyer built from your actual offer, in voice or text, with a coaching score after each call. Built for individual reps rather than enablement teams.
- [ChartCheck: AI Chart Analysis](https://acalise.com/chartcheck/) — AI chart analysis app for iPhone. Screenshot any trading chart - stocks, crypto, forex, futures, ETFs - and get a structured technical read: trend and market structure, support and resistance zones, chart and candlestick patterns, visible indicator readings, a plain-language summary, a confidence level describing how legible the chart was, and an explicit "what I could not see" list. Educational tool; explicitly not financial advice and it does not recommend buying or selling anything.
- [FiberUp](https://acalise.com/fiberup/) — Free dedicated fiber tracker app for iPhone. USDA-verified fiber data, barcode scanner, daily progress ring, weekly plant count tracking. No account required.
- [T-Score](https://acalise.com/tscore/) — Free natural testosterone optimization tracker for iPhone. Tracks sleep, training, sunlight, cold exposure, and nutrition habits scientifically tied to testosterone.
- [Word Walk](https://acalise.com/word-walk/) — Free daily word ladder puzzle game for iPhone. Hand-crafted daily Lewis Carroll-style word ladders, vocabulary training, no ads.
- [Introvert: Daily Courage](https://acalise.com/introvert/) — Free social courage and confidence-building app for introverts. Daily small social challenges to grow comfort with everyday interactions.
- [MenuPics: Instant Picture Menu](https://acalise.com/menupics/) — Free AI menu scanner for iPhone. Snap any text-only restaurant menu and instantly see realistic photos of every dish. Works on foreign-language menus, QR-code PDFs, and chalkboards. No account required. Built on GCP / Cloud Run with Firebase App Check.

## Cold Calling & Sales Practice (CloserLab blog)

- [The 7 Best Sales Roleplay Apps and AI Practice Tools](https://acalise.com/closerlab/blog/best-sales-roleplay-apps/) — Enterprise platforms, team coaching software and the tools an individual rep can actually use alone, compared.
- [Cold Call Anxiety: Why It Happens](https://acalise.com/closerlab/blog/cold-call-anxiety/) — Call reluctance is anticipatory: the dread peaks before dialling and drops once someone answers. What actually reduces it, and why "just make the calls" and "be more confident" do not.
- [How to Practice Cold Calling Alone](https://acalise.com/closerlab/blog/how-to-practice-cold-calling/) — Five solo practice methods ranked by how well each transfers to a live call, and why silent script reading builds recognition rather than the ability to produce words under pressure.
- [Practising Cold Calls With ChatGPT](https://acalise.com/closerlab/blog/practice-cold-calls-with-chatgpt/) — The prompt that stops a chatbot playing a cooperative prospect, how to get useful in-character feedback, and the four things typed roleplay cannot rehearse.
- [How to Get Better at Cold Calling](https://acalise.com/closerlab/blog/how-to-get-better-at-cold-calling/) — What moves the needle in order: list quality, saying why you are calling early, asking rather than pitching, reviewing recordings, and drilling your three worst objections.

## AI Chart Analysis & Technical Analysis (ChartCheck blog)

- [AI Chart Analysis: What It Actually Does, and What It Can't](https://acalise.com/chartcheck/blog/ai-chart-analysis/) — How a vision model reads a chart image, what it reliably identifies (structure, tested levels, named patterns, visible indicators), and the four things it structurally cannot know: anything outside the frame, order flow, fundamentals, and the future.
- [Using ChatGPT for Chart Analysis](https://acalise.com/chartcheck/blog/chart-analysis-with-chatgpt/) — The five specific ways general-purpose chatbots fail on trading charts, including inventing precise price levels interpolated from axis labels, plus a prompt structure that fixes most of them.
- [How to Screenshot a Trading Chart So AI Can Read It](https://acalise.com/chartcheck/blog/screenshot-a-chart-for-analysis/) — The seven things that must stay in frame, why 100-200 candles is the practical range, and the capture mistakes that produce confidently wrong analysis.
- [When AI Chart Analysis Gets It Wrong](https://acalise.com/chartcheck/blog/why-ai-chart-analysis-is-wrong/) — Six recognisable failure modes and how to catch each one, including why a confidence score measures chart legibility rather than the probability a trade works.
- [AI Chart Analysis for Crypto](https://acalise.com/chartcheck/blog/ai-chart-analysis-crypto/) — What a 24/7 market does to classical technical analysis: no gaps, noisier single-candle wick signals, exchange-specific volume, and levels that differ between venues.
- [AI Chart Analysis for Forex](https://acalise.com/chartcheck/blog/ai-chart-analysis-forex/) — No consolidated volume (tick volume only), session structure that is invisible in a screenshot, and why currency pairs move for reasons on both sides.
- [Candlestick Patterns Explained](https://acalise.com/chartcheck/blog/candlestick-patterns-explained/) — Body size, wick length and body position read most candles without memorising names; why location decides whether any pattern is meaningful.
- [Chart Patterns Cheat Sheet](https://acalise.com/chartcheck/blog/chart-patterns-cheat-sheet/) — Continuation and reversal patterns grouped by what they say about supply and demand, with each pattern's invalidation level.
- [How to Read a Stock Chart](https://acalise.com/chartcheck/blog/how-to-read-a-stock-chart/) — A beginner walkthrough in a fixed order: axes and timeframe, trend, structure, levels, then patterns and indicators last.
- [How to Draw Support and Resistance](https://acalise.com/chartcheck/blog/support-and-resistance/) — Zones rather than lines, which levels are worth marking, why repeated tests can weaken a level, and how to tell a real break from a false one.

## App Blockers, Doomscrolling & Boxing (FightMode blog)

- [Best App Blockers to Stop Doomscrolling in 2026](https://acalise.com/fightmode/blog/best-app-blockers/) — 11 app blockers compared across three types: friction apps (One Sec, ScreenZen), hard blockers (Opal, Freedom), and exercise-to-unlock apps (Pushscroll, Repscroll, FightMode).
- [Exercise-to-Unlock Apps Compared](https://acalise.com/fightmode/blog/exercise-to-unlock-apps/) — Every "workout to scroll" app: Pushscroll, Repscroll, FitBlok, UnlockFit, UNLK, Time Out, and FightMode (the boxing one). How they work and which sticks.
- [The Best Pushscroll Alternative in 2026](https://acalise.com/fightmode/blog/pushscroll-alternative/) — Alternatives to Pushscroll's pushup-to-unlock model: Repscroll, FitBlok, EarnScroll, and FightMode's boxing rounds.
- [Boxing App Blocker: The First App Blocker for Fighters](https://acalise.com/fightmode/blog/boxing-app-blocker/) — Why boxing rounds beat pushups as the friction that breaks doomscrolling; how FightMode works end to end.
- [Average Screen Time in 2026](https://acalise.com/fightmode/blog/average-screen-time-statistics/) — Approximate average screen time by age, country, and app category, with how much is too much.
- [10 Beginner Boxing Combos](https://acalise.com/fightmode/blog/beginner-boxing-combos/) — The 1-6 numbering system and ten combinations (1-2, 1-2-3, etc.) explained and ready to drill.

## Fiber & Nutrition (FiberUp blog)

- [Best Fiber Tracker Apps for iPhone in 2026](https://acalise.com/fiberup/blog/best-fiber-tracker-apps/) — Comparison of the 7 best fiber tracker apps including FiberUp, Plant Power, Cronometer, MyFitnessPal. Covers free fiber tracker apps, fibre tracker apps (UK), fiber counter apps.
- [How to Read Nutrition Labels for Fiber](https://acalise.com/fiberup/blog/how-to-read-nutrition-labels-fiber/) — Where fiber appears on US Nutrition Facts panels, % Daily Value, calories per gram of fiber, what 25g/28g/40g of fiber looks like in real food.
- [Best High Fiber Meals for Weight Loss](https://acalise.com/fiberup/blog/high-fiber-meals-weight-loss/) — Sample 30g+ days, recipes by meal, why fiber drives satiety and weight loss.
- [I Tracked My Fiber Intake for 30 Days](https://acalise.com/fiberup/blog/fiber-tracking-30-days/) — First-person experiment with measurable outcomes.

## Testosterone (T-Score blog)

- [20 Foods That Boost Testosterone](https://acalise.com/tscore/blog/foods-that-boost-testosterone/) — Evidence-based food list (oysters, eggs, fatty fish, beef, Brazil nuts, pumpkin seeds, olive oil), separated from internet myths (celery, asparagus). Why no food contains usable testosterone directly.
- [Testosterone Levels by Age](https://acalise.com/tscore/blog/testosterone-levels-by-age/) — Normal testosterone ranges (ng/mL and ng/dL) by decade.

- [Daily Word Games Like Wordle](https://acalise.com/word-walk/blog/daily-word-games-like-wordle/) — Wordle alternatives for daily play.
- [Best Word Puzzle Games for iPhone](https://acalise.com/word-walk/blog/best-word-puzzle-games-iphone/) — iOS word game roundup.
- [Free Word Games (No Ads)](https://acalise.com/word-walk/blog/free-word-games-no-ads/) — Genuinely free word games without ads.
- [Word Games for Seniors](https://acalise.com/word-walk/blog/word-games-for-seniors/) — Best word games for older adults, with cognitive-research notes.
- [Word Games for Kids](https://acalise.com/word-walk/blog/word-games-for-kids/) — Kid-friendly word puzzles by age range.
- [Offline Word Games (No Wi-Fi)](https://acalise.com/word-walk/blog/offline-word-games-no-wifi/) — Word games that work without internet.
- [Word Games Like Connections](https://acalise.com/word-walk/blog/word-games-like-connections/) — Alternatives to NYT Connections and Strands.
- [Lewis Carroll's Famous Word Ladders](https://acalise.com/word-walk/blog/lewis-carroll-famous-word-ladders/) — The original 1877 Doublets puzzles and solutions.

## Restaurant Menus & Ordering (MenuPics blog)

- [The Picky Eater's Guide to Ordering at Any Restaurant](https://acalise.com/menupics/blog/picky-eater-restaurant-guide/) — Pre-restaurant tactics, universal safe categories, cuisine-specific picky-eater picks, ARFID disclaimers.
- [Why Restaurant Menus Stopped Including Pictures](https://acalise.com/menupics/blog/menus-without-pictures/) — Status code shift, photography costs, QR-code PDF size limits, accessibility consequences.
- [Best AI Menu Scanner Apps for iPhone in 2026](https://acalise.com/menupics/blog/best-ai-menu-apps/) — Honest ranking covering Google Translate, MenuPics, Yelp's menu scanner, MenuGuide, AnyMenu, Picknic, Gluten Dude, Equal Eats.
- [50 Fancy Menu Terms Decoded: From Aioli to Velouté](https://acalise.com/menupics/blog/decode-menu-terms/) — Cooking methods (confit, sous vide, braised), sauces (béarnaise, romesco, agrodolce), preparation styles (crudo, carpaccio, tartare), specific dishes.
- [Reading Restaurant Menus With Dyslexia or ADHD: 7 Tools](https://acalise.com/menupics/blog/dyslexia-adhd-menu-reading/) — Apple Speak Screen, Microsoft Seeing AI, picture menu apps, and how to choose accessible-friendly restaurants.
